# Todd Margolis

> Portfolio of Todd Margolis — researcher, strategist, and artist. Tagline: "Materializing the Invisible." Over two decades translating academic inquiry in visualization, virtual reality, immersive analytics, and generative AI into scalable products and experiential artworks. Practice spans Varrier™ autostereoscopic VR at UIC's Electronic Visualization Lab, technical direction at UCSD's CRCA and Qualcomm Institute, Sr. Director of Applied Research at Qlik, and the Observables body of work exploring cosmic light-travel time through astrophotography, sculpture, and interactive installation.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://toddmargolis.net/) - Landing page with three practice pillars (Research, Strategy, Creative) and aurora background video
- [About](https://toddmargolis.net/bio/) - Biography covering engineering, telepresence, product strategy, and current artistic practice
- [Research](https://toddmargolis.net/research/) - Research projects organized by Display & Interaction Systems, Collaborative Environments, Publications & Theory, and Pedagogy & Labs
- [Strategy](https://toddmargolis.net/strategy/) - Leadership and institutional roles in R&D Leadership, Academic Practice, and Cultural Stewardship
- [Creative](https://toddmargolis.net/creative/) - Artworks organized by Tangible Artifacts, Immersive Installations, Augmented Interventions, and Performative Systems
- [Works](https://toddmargolis.net/works/) - Searchable index of all projects with tag filtering and chronological sorting
- [CV](https://toddmargolis.net/narrative/) - Embedded curriculum vitae (Google Docs)
- [Connect](https://toddmargolis.net/contact/) - Contact page (info@toddmargolis.net, Chicago IL)
- [Logistics](https://toddmargolis.net/logistics/) - Authenticated page with exhibition technical requirements and downloadable prospectus PDF
- [Sitemap](https://toddmargolis.net/sitemap.xml) - Machine-readable URL index for all pages and project detail pages
